description: This file defines a Razor Pages model class ErrorModel used for handling error pages in an ASP.NET Core web application. It contains properties to hold request identifiers and a method to initialize the data when the page is accessed.

classes.name: ErrorModel
classes.description: A Razor Pages PageModel class used for handling application error display, storing request identifiers, and determining whether to show them.

methods.name: OnGet
methods.description: Handles GET requests to the error page by setting the RequestId property with the current activity ID or HTTP context trace identifier.
